description: See what emails your agent has sent: lists sent messages for its @divindi.io address. Use this to confirm a divimail_send went out or to review history. For received mail use divimail_inbox. Needs a token. Optional limit (default 20).

email.description: Your agent's full @divindi.io email address (e.g. myagent@divindi.io)

token.description: JWT token from divimail_login, divimail_authenticate or divimail_service_token

name: divimail_sent
